jsonld.description: Catering company serving Hollywood, FL and South Florida: seafood rice, grilled meats, wings and comfort food trays for private events, birthdays and staff lunches.

script.es: Sabor de verdad, siempre a tiempo.
script.en: Real flavor, served on time, every time.

parrafo.es: M&D Cuisine and Catering atiende Hollywood, FL y el sur de Florida con bandejas completas de arroz con mariscos, alitas, chuletas de cordero y más, servidas con verdadero cuidado. Los clientes repiten lo mismo: la comida es consistentemente buena y el equipo cumple, incluso con poco aviso.
parrafo.en: M&D Cuisine and Catering serves Hollywood, FL and South Florida with full trays of seafood rice, wings, lamb chops and more, plated with real care. Clients keep saying the same thing: the food is consistently great and the team delivers, even on short notice.

hero.imagen_alt: Catering spread with seafood rice, wings, grilled steak salad, shrimp, mac and cheese and mashed potatoes by M&D Cuisine and Catering

parrafo_1.es: M&D Cuisine and Catering es un equipo de catering en Hollywood, FL. Cocinan bandejas completas para cumpleaños, almuerzos de oficina y eventos privados en el sur de Florida: arroz con mariscos, chuletas de cordero, alitas, mac and cheese y más, servidos para lucirse, no solo para comerse.
parrafo_1.en: M&D Cuisine and Catering is a Hollywood, FL catering team. They cook full-service trays for birthdays, staff lunches and private events across South Florida: seafood rice, lamb chops, wings, mac and cheese and more, plated to be shown off, not just eaten.

parrafo_2.es: Los clientes repiten las mismas dos palabras: consistente y rápido. Un grupo necesitó comida para más de 50 personas con menos de 24 horas de aviso, y el equipo igual entregó una comida que todos elogiaron.
parrafo_2.en: Clients keep coming back to the same two words: consistent and fast. One group needed food for over 50 people with less than 24 hours notice, and the team still delivered a meal everyone raved about.

items.quote: We are visiting from out of state for a soccer tournament and needed a place to accommodate our group of 50+ on short notice. They went above and beyond to make it happen! The service was outstanding, and the food was absolutely fantastic. Everyone in our group had a great experience. Highly recommend!

What a great experience for my staff luncheon. Every raved about the Seafood rice and Lamb chops. The catering services was on time and communicate via email with me during the planning process. Presentation of food was so creative. Thanks again M & D for your services.
The food was PHENOMENAL. We are in town and asked them to feed over 50 people on less than 24 hours notice and THEY DELIVERED! Couldn't thank you guys enough. Everyone loved it!

Food is amazing. Chef is the bomb. Food is seasoned well and every bit is delicious. And food is consistently good. Haven't changed in the 1 yr that I have been eating their food. If you haven't had their food make sure you book them for your next event. Promise you won't be disappointed.
